reason: Both describe the identical mechanism: is_near_duplicate uses `<= threshold` where it should use `>= threshold`, inverting the comparison so near-identical/high-similarity embeddings are reported as not-duplicates while dissimilar/orthogonal (low-similarity) embeddings are reported as duplicates.
